constructs.name: pOpen-TetO-PLA
findings: Reused verbatim from this board's devnote/mk-mb-devnote2 (dna/pOpen-TetO-PLA.gb), unmodified. That file's own provenance note still applies: built from an inline sequence in that DevNote's source Doc, not from a canonical nucleus-eng/DNA file, and its PLA1 CDS matches devnote-op-20261001-luv-gel-pla/dna/t7pro-esao-ls1-pla1.gbk at the part level.
Named pOpen-PLA in this Doc's Materials table and pOpen-TetO-PLA in its Results captions; treated as the same construct.

constructs.name: pOpen-TetO-deGFP
findings: Reused verbatim from this board's devstudio/devnote-mk-20260925-20260928 (dna/pOpen-TetO-deGFP.gb), unmodified, not yet merged to main. That file's own provenance note still applies: built from an inline sequence in that DevNote's source Doc, not from a canonical nucleus-eng/DNA file.
Named pOpen-deGFP in this Doc's Materials table and pOpen-TetO-deGFP in its Results captions; treated as the same construct.

constructs.name: TetR-His (MedChemExpress)
findings: A purchased purified protein, not a construct built here. Used both as supplied and after a detergent-removal spin column.

constructs.name: CF TetR / CF deGFP
findings: In-house cell-free expressed TetR and its deGFP sham, supplied as 3 uL (main experiment) or 2.5 uL (follow-up) of a finished overnight or 1 h reaction, not a purified or sequenced construct in its own right.

constructs.name: beta-galactosidase (LacZ)
findings: A purchased enzyme co-encapsulated as the lysis reporter, not a construct built here. The source Doc's Materials table lists its stock concentration as 'see open items,' which the Doc never resolves.
